verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent answers using your content (pylon-docs-13, pylon-docs-22). Natural-language runbooks and persona settings could be used to steer its behavior (pylon-docs-15, pylon-docs-57). You can also simulate questions before deploying (pylon-docs-17) and apply QA rubrics afterward (pylon-docs-74), but none of these is a documented guardrail against made-up policies, prices or promises. Missing for 10: an explicit grounding or anti-hallucination guardrail, documented safe-decline behavior for off-knowledge questions, controls that block invented prices or commitments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
